abyss.$description: Page canvas. Level 0. All content sits on this.

deep.$description: Recessed well. Level 1. Audit trail, telemetry chart well, empty-state panels, footer.

kelp.$description: Raised card. Level 2. Asset cards, work-order panels, KPI tiles, table wrappers, input fields.

slate.$description: Low-emphasis tint only — gridlines, borders, and the decommissioned/cancelled marker dot. Never used as text color: fails WCAG AA on both Abyss (3.52:1) and Kelp (2.88:1). Use text.silver for decommissioned/cancelled labels instead.

platinum.$description: Headings, primary nav, asset tags, icon strokes. Never for body text.

mist.$description: Emphasized body text, eyebrow labels, healthy-state markers, live telemetry line.

silver.$description: Default body text, table cells, metadata, inactive nav.

lavender.$description: KPI figures, emphasis statistics, field error text. Never body text or controls. No longer used as a critical-state marker — see color.alarm.

aurora-cyan.$description: Gradient stop only. Not for solid fills.

teal-signal.$description: Gradient start stop only. Not for solid fills.

critical.$description: Added per decisions.md #4. CRITICAL status tags and the telemetry CRITICAL threshold line only — never decorative. 5.80:1 on Abyss, 4.74:1 on Kelp, 6.34:1 on Deep.

warning.$description: Added per decisions.md #4. WARNING status tags only (alerts) — never decorative. 8.81:1 on Abyss, 7.19:1 on Kelp, 9.62:1 on Deep.

bioluminescent.$description: Signature gradient. Primary CTA fill only.

aurora.$description: Decorative accent. Small accents only. Never on text, borders, chart fills, or large backgrounds.

display.$description: Primary face for headings and body. Weights 400 and 500 only.

ui.$description: Form labels, button text, table headers. 14px only.

medium.$description: All headings and kinetic text. No bold, no light.

caption.$description: Status tags, criticality labels, chart axis micro-labels.

label.$description: Ghost nav links, eyebrow labels (smaller), form labels.

meta.$description: Statistic labels, timestamps, asset metadata. Tracking value is not in the source reference; confirm with design (see open-decisions).

heading.$description: Panel and screen headings in the console.

heading-lg.$description: Landing and empty-state headline. Not used on live-data screens.

kinetic.$description: Oversized kinetic text. Login and empty-state hero only.

unit.$description: Base unit. All spacing is a multiple of 4.

card-padding.$description: Default card padding. Source gives a 36-48px range; 48px is for feature rows only.

recessed-padding.$description: Landing and empty-state recessed panels only. Use 36px inside console screens.

small.$description: Buttons, inputs, status tags, arrow icon buttons.

prose-max-width.$description: Narrow reading column in detail views.

reduced.$description: Replace the particle sphere with a still frame. Stop kinetic text movement.

$metadata.name: Industrial Maintenance Platform tokens
$metadata.note: Values copied from the source reference. Items marked in $description need design confirmation.
